title: The Day the Chimney Pots Took Flight
description: When the last hearth fires go out, the chimney pots lift off and head for the coast. Neighbors raise a cup from their attic windows as they pass.
alt: Terracotta chimney pots trail ribbons of smoke over a hillside town at dawn while neighbors raise cups from two attic windows.
pairing: End of hearth season × a migration of terracotta chimney pots
